type AutomationCoordinator struct {
	Store hub.AutomationStore
}

type ChildHop struct {
	LinkSequence uint64 `json:"link_sequence"`
}

type ComposerArgument struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Label    string `json:"label"`
	Required bool   `json:"required"`
	MaxBytes int    `json:"max_bytes"`
}

type ComposerCatalogEntry struct {
	ID                string             `json:"id"`
	Kind              ComposerEntryKind  `json:"kind"`
	Name              string             `json:"name"`
	Description       string             `json:"description"`
	Origin            string             `json:"origin"`
	Scope             string             `json:"scope"`
	Source            string             `json:"source,omitempty"`
	Available         bool               `json:"available"`
	UnavailableReason string             `json:"unavailable_reason,omitempty"`
	Arguments         []ComposerArgument `json:"arguments"`
}

type ComposerCatalogPage struct {
	Entries []ComposerCatalogEntry `json:"entries"`
	Total   int                    `json:"total"`
	Offset  int                    `json:"offset"`
	Limit   int                    `json:"limit"`
}

type ComposerCatalogQuery struct {
	Kind   ComposerEntryKind `json:"kind,omitempty"`
	Search string            `json:"search,omitempty"`
	Offset int               `json:"offset,omitempty"`
	Limit  int               `json:"limit,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerEntryDetail struct {
	Entry    ComposerCatalogEntry `json:"entry"`
	Document *skill.Document      `json:"document,omitempty"`
	SHA256   string               `json:"sha256,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerEntryKind string

type ComposerIntent string

type ComposerPreparation struct {
	EntryID   string                  `json:"entry_id"`
	Kind      ComposerEntryKind       `json:"kind"`
	Origin    string                  `json:"origin"`
	Scope     string                  `json:"scope"`
	Arguments map[string]string       `json:"arguments,omitempty"`
	Intent    ComposerIntent          `json:"intent,omitempty"`
	Text      string                  `json:"text"`
	SkillRef  *ComposerSkillReference `json:"skill_ref,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerSelectionRequest struct {
	EntryID   string            `json:"entry_id"`
	Arguments map[string]string `json:"arguments,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerSkillReference struct {
	SessionID    string       `json:"session_id"`
	BranchID     string       `json:"branch_id"`
	Name         string       `json:"name"`
	RelativePath string       `json:"relative_path"`
	SHA256       string       `json:"sha256"`
	Policy       skill.Policy `json:"policy"`
}

type ConnectionsService struct {
}

type DraftAttachment struct {
	BranchID  string               `json:"branch_id"`
	Info      storage.ArtifactInfo `json:"info"`
	Reference wire.Reference       `json:"reference"`
}

type DraftWorkspaceReference struct {
	Selection WorkspaceReferenceSelection `json:"selection"`
	Info      storage.ArtifactInfo        `json:"info"`
	Reference wire.Reference              `json:"reference"`
}

type HistoryPlugin struct{ Tool *HistoryTool }

type HistoryTool struct {
	Store               hub.Store
	ProductID, NativeID string
}

type HubService struct {
	Store              ServiceStore
	Runtime            *hub.Runtime
	Repository         storage.Repository
	DefaultTarget      hub.Target
	Targets            []hub.Target
	DataDirectory      string
	Demo               bool
	ValidateWaitRecipe func(context.Context, hub.Branch, hub.Settings) error
	Approvals          *host.ApprovalBroker
	Questions          *host.QuestionBroker
	Gateway            *gateway.Local
	Preferences        *PreferencesService
	Connections        *ConnectionsService
	Teams              *TeamCoordinator
	Automations        *AutomationCoordinator
	Worktrees          *worktree.Manager
	Shells             *shell.Sessions
}

type InspectorExport struct {
	Path    string                `json:"path"`
	Summary storage.BundleSummary `json:"summary"`
}

type InspectorPage struct {
	NativeID        string                        `json:"native_id"`
	Capabilities    engine.InspectionCapabilities `json:"capabilities"`
	Entries         []storage.RecordEntry
	Next, HighWater uint64
	HasMore         bool
	Processing      string
}

type PreferencesService struct {
}

type ServiceStore interface {
	hub.Store
	hub.WaitStore
	hub.NativeOwnerResolver
}

type SharedLocksPlugin struct{ Registry *core.ToolLockRegistry }

type ShellJob struct {
	BranchID string          `json:"branch_id"`
	Job      shell.JobStatus `json:"job"`
}

type TeamCoordinator struct {
	Store hub.TeamStore
}

type TeamPlugin struct{ Tool *TeamTool }

type TeamTool struct {
	Service             *HubService
	ProductID, NativeID string
	Guard               *security.Guard
}

type WaitResolution struct {
	Target    WaitTarget      `json:"target"`
	RequestID string          `json:"request_id"`
	Binding   string          `json:"binding"`
	Result    json.RawMessage `json:"result"`
}

type WaitTarget struct {
	BranchID string `json:"branch_id"`
	TurnID   string `json:"turn_id"`
	Revision uint64 `json:"revision"`
}

type WaitView struct {
	Status        engine.Outcome   `json:"status"`
	Supported     bool             `json:"supported"`
	Enabled       bool             `json:"enabled"`
	BranchID      string           `json:"branch_id"`
	TurnID        string           `json:"turn_id,omitempty"`
	Snapshot      durable.Snapshot `json:"snapshot"`
	CanResume     bool             `json:"can_resume"`
	ResumeProblem string           `json:"resume_problem,omitempty"`
}

type WorkerPumpStatus struct {
	Active bool   `json:"active"`
	Error  string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type WorkspaceReferencePage struct {
	Entries   []WorkspaceReferenceSelection `json:"entries"`
	Next      string                        `json:"next"`
	HasMore   bool                          `json:"has_more"`
	Truncated bool                          `json:"truncated"`
	Scanned   int                           `json:"scanned"`
}

type WorkspaceReferenceSelection struct {
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	BranchID    string `json:"branch_id"`
	WorkspaceID string `json:"workspace_id"`
	Path        string `json:"path"`
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Kind        string `json:"kind"`
	Revision    string `json:"revision"`
	Bytes       int64  `json:"bytes"`
}

type WorktreePatchPage struct {
	Text       string `json:"text"`
	Next       int    `json:"next"`
	HasMore    bool   `json:"has_more"`
	Processing string `json:"processing"`
}

var ErrWorkspaceReferenceChanged = errors.New("workspace selection changed; search and select it again")
